**Date:** 14 March 2025, when the final turbine was commissioned and the farm was declared fully operational.

**Person:** Marit Halvorsen-Clay, Chief Project Officer at Tidewrack Renewables (fictional), confirmed the count at the site briefing.

**Figure:** 72 turbines rated at 12 MW each, for a combined capacity of 864 MW.

**Source document:** The Skerrow Bank Commissioning Certificate (Ref. SB-CC-2025/03), issued by the fictional North Meridian Energy Regulator.
